purpose: Review one finite seven-route local-data catalog after Campaign261 and select at most one genuinely independent three-session mechanism before reading any Campaign262 source row or scientific value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_change_reversal_rate_236p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Count sign reversals between adjacent within-half changes in log1p amount.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It is another turning-point count over the same amount path as terminal intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p; changing peak-only counting to symmetric sign reversals would reopen that exposed family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_schedule_uniformity_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Measure one minus the normalized L1 area between the cumulative amount-share curve and the fixed uniform 240-bar schedule.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It is a parameter-free full-clock distribution distance to a fixed non-data-dependent execution schedule. It is not determined by amount magnitude inequality, the first three clock moments, local order, peaks, fixed windows or a second profile; practical redundancy remains subject to all 142 frozen comparisons.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_schedule_l2_distance_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Square and sum cumulative-share deviations from the uniform schedule.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing L1 versus L2, Cramer-von Mises or a maximum deviation would create an estimator sweep; Campaign262 freezes L1 once.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_half_session_amount_schedule_uniformity_2h
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Compute separate morning and afternoon schedule distances and average or subtract them.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Resetting at lunch and choosing an average, minimum, maximum or difference adds window and direction degrees of freedom.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_schedule_market_or_u_shape_adherence_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Compare cumulative own-stock amount with a fitted market or empirical U-shaped benchmark.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A learned benchmark would add sample dependence and overlap market amount-profile synchronization; the selected benchmark is exactly uniform and frozen without values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_clock_quantile_deviation_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Summarize amount-arrival quartiles or median clock displacement.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Quantile choice would extend the exposed center, dispersion and third-moment clock family; Campaign262 instead integrates the complete cumulative curve against one fixed schedule.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: amount_schedule_terminal_factor_combination_or_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Combine schedule adherence with Gini, entropy, timing moments, price, return or prior terminal scores.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign262 is one raw-source definition with no fit, subset, old score or combination.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_amount_schedule_uniformity_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A session whose CNY trading amount is replenished broadly across the complete trading clock, rather than arriving in a few temporally displaced blocks, reflects more orderly inventory transfer that may persist over the next three accepted sessions.
selected_candidate.formula_summary: For p_i=a_i/S, F_k=sum_{i=0}^k p_i and U_k=(k+1)/240 for k=0..238, score=1-sum_k|F_k-U_k|/119.5.
